items.name: APC segment backlog, June 30 2026
items.claim: Fuel Tech's Air Pollution Control (APC) segment backlog was $14.3 million at June 30, 2026, compared to $7.0 million at December 31, 2025.
items.source_excerpt: Consolidated APC segment backlog at June 30, 2026 was $14.3 million compared to $7.0 million at December 31, 2025.

items.name: APC utility grid enhancement award, Midwest
items.claim: Fuel Tech's APC segment backlog includes recently awarded contracts valued at $10 million, associated primarily with a utility grid enhancement project in the Midwest.
items.source_excerpt: recently awarded APC contracts valued at $10 million associated primarily with a utility grid enhancement project in the Midwest.
